about.heading: About
bio: With 17+ years in software, I have led products from concept to production for global markets.
My focus spans AI products, technical platforms, e-commerce, and fintech where speed and quality must coexist.
I bring a hands-on development background, which keeps strategy grounded in practical delivery realities.
I have worked across large international environments and leading Iranian companies including Digikala, Tapsi, Irancell, and Ertebat Farda (Bank Ayandeh).
Today I help teams design clear product bets, execute with discipline, and launch with confidence.
